Mandatory content enters verbatim; large logs are compacted; large documents stay outside and enter through references; stale content is dropped. Active context remains inside a finite budget. Derived items retain provenance to versioned sources; when a source version changes, dependent representations become stale and must be revalidated or rehydrated.
